claims.claim: The clique number of H is 3.
claims.evidence: Because H is the complement of C7, an H-clique is an independent set of C7. Selecting alternate vertices around an odd 7-cycle gives at most floor(7/2)=3 vertices, while {v0,v2,v4} is an H-clique of size 3. Exhaustive enumeration of all 128 subsets confirmed omega(H)=3.
claims.search_method: Complement argument plus exhaustive enumeration of all subsets of the seven H-vertices.
claims.witness: {v0,v2,v4} is a clique of H of size 3.

claims.evidence: Every clique contains at most omega(H)=3 vertices from H and at most p and q, so it has size at most 5. Exact enumeration confirmed omega(G)=5 and checked all C(9,6)=84 six-vertex subsets without finding a clique.
claims.search_method: Deduction from omega(H)=3, independently confirmed by exhaustive testing of every six-vertex subset of G.

claims.claim: H has no induced cycle of length at least 5.
claims.evidence: If H[S] were Ck, then C7[S] would be the complement of Ck. For k at least 6, every vertex in that complement has degree k-3 at least 3, impossible in an induced subgraph of C7. For k=5, the complement is again C5, whereas a proper induced subgraph of C7 is a disjoint union of paths. The checker independently tested all 29 subsets of sizes 5, 6, and 7 and found no induced cycle.
claims.search_method: Complement-and-degree proof plus exact connected-2-regular testing of every eligible H-subset.

claims.claim: G has no induced odd cycle of length at least 5.
claims.evidence: An induced cycle of length at least 5 cannot contain p or q: either universal vertex would have induced degree k-1 rather than 2. Such a cycle would therefore lie in H, where claim 3 excludes it. Exact testing found no cycle among all 163 odd-sized candidate subsets; testing all 256 subsets of G of size at least 5 established the stronger absence of every long induced cycle.
claims.search_method: Universal-vertex chord argument plus exhaustive connected-2-regular testing of all eligible odd subsets of G.

claims.claim: The independence number of H is 2.
claims.evidence: An independent set in H is a clique in C7. The cycle C7 is triangle-free but has edges, so its clique number, and hence alpha(H), is exactly 2. Exhaustive subset enumeration confirmed this value.
claims.search_method: Complement argument plus exhaustive enumeration of all subsets of H.
claims.witness: {v0,v1} is an independent set of H of size 2.
